questions.text: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में मौद्रिक नीति _______ द्वारा प्रतिपादित की जाती है।
questions.text_english: The monetary policy is formulated by the _______ in the Indian economy.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank of India and is mandated by the RBI Act, 1934, to formulate, implement, and monitor the monetary policy to maintain price stability and ensure adequate flow of credit to productive sectors. Other options are incorrect as the government formulates fiscal policy, not monetary policy.

questions.text: पहचान करें कि, किसी देश के राजस्व घाटे का अनुमान लगाते समय निम्नलिखित में से किस पर विचार 'नहीं' किया जाना चाहिए ।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following is not to be considered while estimating Revenue Deficit of a country.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option)

options.A: सरकार द्वारा भुगतान की गई मजदूरी व वेतन
options.B: केन्द्रीय सरकार द्वारा किया गया ब्याज भुगतान
options.D: ऊपरीगामी पथ (flyover) के निर्माण पर व्यय

options_english.A: Wages and salaries paid by the government
options_english.B: Interest payments made by the Central Government
options_english.D: Expenditure incurred on construction of flyover

questions.solution: Revenue deficit is calculated as the difference between Revenue Expenditure and Revenue Receipts. Construction of a flyover is a capital expenditure as it creates an asset, and therefore it is not considered while calculating the Revenue Deficit.

questions.text: कीन्स के अर्थशास्त्र के अंतर्गत, _______ को मूल बिंदु से प्रारंभ कर 45° कोण पर खींचा जाता है।
questions.text_english: In the Keynesian Economics, _______ starts from the origin and is always drawn at an angle of 45°.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: In Keynesian macroeconomics, the 45-degree line represents the reference line along which aggregate expenditure equals national income (Y = C + S). It is used as a benchmark to determine the equilibrium level of income.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से एक सही विकल्प का चयन करें :
अभिकथन (A) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुओं के संदर्भ में किसी भी व्यक्ति को लाभ उठाने से वंचित नहीं किया जा सकता है।
कारण (R) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ गैर-प्रतिद्वंद्वात्मक व गैर-अपवर्जनीय प्रकृति की होती हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct options given below :
Assertion (A): In case of public goods no one can be excluded from enjoying the benefits.
Reason (R): Public goods are non-rivalrous and non-excludable in nature.
questions.instruction_line: विकल्प :
questions.instruction_line_english: Options:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Public goods possess the characteristics of non-excludability and non-rivalry. Because they are non-excludable, it is impossible to prevent anyone from consuming them, which validates Assertion (A). The reason provided correctly explains why exclusion is impossible.

questions.text: मूल्य संवर्धन = _______ - मध्यवर्ती उपभोग का मूल्य ।
questions.text_english: Value Addition = _______ - Value of Intermediate Consumption.
questions.instruction_line:
(उपरोक्त सूत्र की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें)
(i) घरेलू बिक्री
(ii) बिक्री- स्टॉक में परिवर्तन
(iii) उत्पादन का मूल्य
(iv) (उत्पादित इकाइयों की संख्या) × (मूल्य प्रति इकाई)
questions.instruction_line_english:
(Choose the correct option(s) to complete the stated formula.)
(i) Domestic sales
(ii) Sales-change in stock
(iii) Value of output
(iv) (Number of units produced) × (Price per unit)
questions.solution: Value added is calculated as the Value of Output minus Intermediate Consumption. The 'Value of Output' is equal to Sales plus change in stock. Sales are calculated as (Number of units sold) × (Price per unit). Thus, options (ii), (iii), and (iv) are all components that define or lead to the value of output.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, स्वायत्त उपभोग ₹ 100 करोड़ है तथा कुल उपभोग ₹ 130 करोड़ है। प्रेरित उपभोग का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ होगा।
questions.text_english: Suppose for an economy, autonomous consumption stands as 100 crore and total consumption is 130 crores. The value of induced consumption would be _______ crore.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: Total consumption is the sum of autonomous consumption (C-bar) and induced consumption (bY). Given Total Consumption = 130 and Autonomous Consumption = 100, Induced Consumption = Total Consumption - Autonomous Consumption, which is 130 - 100 = 30 crore.

questions.text: बैंकों के बैंकर के रूप में, भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक _______ के अतिरिक्त सभी कार्य करता है।
questions.text_english: As the Banker to the Bank, Reserve Bank of India performs all functions except ***.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)

options.A: जन साधारण की ओर से प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद और बिक्री
options.B: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के चालू खाता रखने
options.C: अंतबैंकीय लेनदेनों का समाशोधन व भुगतान

options_english.A: Purchase and sale of securities on behalf of general public
options_english.B: Maintaining current account for Commercial Banks
options_english.C: Clearing and settlement of Interbank transactions

questions.solution: The RBI acts as a banker to the banks by maintaining their accounts, facilitating clearing of interbank transactions, and acting as a lender of last resort. It does not deal with or purchase/sell securities directly on behalf of the general public; it deals with financial institutions and the government.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों - अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से एक सही विकल्प का चयन करें :
अभिकथन (A) : यदि सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति का मान 0.5 है, तो सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति, सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति के बराबर होगी ।
कारण (R) : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति व सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति का योग सदैव इकाई के बराबर होता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct options given below :
Assertion (A) If the value of Marginal Propensity to Save is 0.5, Marginal Propensity to Consume will be equal to Marginal Propensity to Save.
Reason (R) Sum of Marginal Propensity to Consume and Marginal Propensity to Save always equals to unity.
questions.instruction_line: विकल्प :
questions.instruction_line_english: Options:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is false because MPC + MPS = 1. If MPS is 0.5, then MPC must be 0.5. While in this specific case they are equal, the assertion states they will *be* equal, implying a rule, whereas the Reason (R) correctly identifies that they sum to unity.

questions.text: वह बजट जिसके अंतर्गत, सरकार अपने द्वारा एकत्रित राजस्व के बराबर राशि व्यय कर सकती है, उसे _______ बजट कहा जाता है।
questions.text_english: The budget under, which the government may spend an amount equal to the revenue it collects is referred as _______ Budget.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: A balanced budget is one where estimated government revenue equals estimated government expenditure. In contrast, surplus and deficit budgets occur when revenue exceeds expenditure or vice-versa, respectively.

questions.text: आय के संतुलन स्तर के मूल्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रत्याक्षित _______ व प्रत्याक्षित _______ के मध्य समानता होनी चाहिए।
questions.text_english: To arrive at the value of equilibrium level of income, there must exists an equality between ex-ante _______ and ex-ante ***.
questions.instruction_line:
(रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।)
(i) समग्र माँग, समग्र पूर्ति
(ii) समग्र माँग, बचत
(iii) समग्र माँग, निवेश
(iv) बचत, निवेश
questions.instruction_line_english:
(Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
(i) Aggregate Demand, Aggregate Supply
(ii) Aggregate Demand, Savings
(iii) Aggregate Demand, Investment
(iv) Savings, Investment
questions.solution: Equilibrium in an economy is achieved when Aggregate Demand equals Aggregate Supply (AD = AS). Since AS is equal to total output and consumption plus saving, AD = AS is equivalent to Savings = Investment (S = I). Thus, both (i) and (iv) are correct definitions.

questions.text: सकल घरेलू उत्पाद अवस्फीतिक (GDP deflator) के अर्थ व महत्त्व का उल्लेख करें।
questions.text_english: State the meaning and significance of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator.

key_points: Meaning: Ratio of Nominal GDP to Real GDP.
Formula: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) x 100.
Significance: Measure of general price level in an economy.

questions.solution: The GDP deflator is an index that measures the change in prices of all domestically produced final goods and services in an economy. It is calculated as the ratio of Nominal GDP to Real GDP multiplied by 100. It is significant because it provides a comprehensive measure of inflation, reflecting price changes across the entire economy rather than just a selected basket of goods, like the Consumer Price Index.

questions.text:
(a) निम्नलिखित कथनों की मान्य तर्कों द्वारा पुष्टि करें :
(i) किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा आपूर्ति स्टॉक चर का उदाहरण है।
(ii) केन्द्रीय बैंक सरकार को विभिन्न बैंकिंग सेवाएँ प्रदान करता है।
अथवा
(b) किसी काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए यह मानते हुए कि, केन्द्रीय बैंक आरक्षित अनुपात को 20% से बढ़ाकर 25% कर देता है तथा कुल प्राथमिक जमा राशि ₹ 1,000 है। वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा साख सृजन पर आरक्षित अनुपात में वृद्धि के प्रभाव की व्याख्या करें ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Justify the following statements with valid arguments:
(i) Money supply in an economy is an example of a stock variable.
(ii) The Central Bank provides several Banking services to the government.
OR
(b) Assuming for a hypothetical economy, Central Bank increases the Reserve Ratio from 20% to 25% and the total primary deposits stand at 1,000. Explain the effect of rise in Reserve Ratio on credit creation by commercial banks.

key_points: Part (a)(i): Stock variable is measured at a point in time; Money supply is a stock.
Part (a)(ii): RBI acts as a banker, agent, and advisor to the government.
Part (b): Money multiplier = 1/Reserve Ratio. Higher ratio means lower multiplier, reducing credit creation.

questions.solution: (a)(i) Money supply is a stock variable because it is measured at a particular point in time, representing the total volume of money circulating in the economy. (a)(ii) The Central Bank serves the government as a banker by managing its accounts, as an agent by managing public debt, and as an advisor by formulating economic policies. (b) With a Reserve Ratio of 20%, the money multiplier is 5 (1/0.20), creating credit of 5,000 (1,000 x 5). If the ratio increases to 25%, the multiplier becomes 4 (1/0.25), creating credit of only 4,000. Thus, an increase in the reserve ratio reduces the banking system's capacity for credit creation.

questions.text:
मान लीजिए कि, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए सरकार ₹ 1,200 करोड़ के वृद्धिशील निवेश के साथ द्रुतगामी मार्गों के निर्माण की दो परियोजनाओं का प्रस्ताव रखती है। मान लीजिए कि, आय में वृद्धि का 80% उपभोग पर व्यय किया जाता है। उपरोक्त सूचना के आधार पर निम्नलिखित का अनुमान लगाएँ :
(a) आय में परिवर्तन (ΔY)
(b) उपभोग में परिवर्तन (ΔC)
questions.text_english:
Suppose for an economy, government proposes project for construction of expressways with an incremental investment of 1200 crore. Assuming, 80% of increase in income is spent on consumption. Estimate the following on the basis of above information:
(a) Change in income (ΔY)
(b) Change in consumption (ΔC)

key_points: Multiplier k = 1 / (1-MPC) = 1 / 0.2 = 5.
ΔY = k * ΔI = 5 * 1200 = 6000 crore.
ΔC = MPC * ΔY = 0.8 * 6000 = 4800 crore.

questions.solution: Given MPC is 0.8. The investment multiplier (k) is 1 / (1-MPC) = 1 / 0.2 = 5. (a) Change in Income (ΔY) = k × ΔI = 5 × 1200 = 6000 crore. (b) Change in consumption (ΔC) = MPC × ΔY = 0.8 × 6000 = 4800 crore.

(b) (i) गौहर ने हाल ही में अपनी फैशन डिजाइनिंग की पढ़ाई पूरी की है तथा एक बुटीक प्रारंभ किया है। बिक्री के लिए कपड़े बनाने के लिए उसने एक सिलाई मशीन, कपड़ा, बटन व धागे क्रय किए हैं। ये सभी वस्तुएँ कपड़े बनाने के लिए आवश्यक हैं। गौहर द्वारा क्रय किए गए सामान को अंतिम वस्तुओं व मध्यवर्ती वस्तुओं में वैध कारणों द्वारा वर्गीकृत करें।
(ii) "एक द्वि-क्षेत्रक अर्थव्यवस्था में, राष्ट्रीय आय सदैव घरेलू आय के बराबर होती है।" मान्य कारणों द्वारा उपरोक्त कथन का समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) On the basis of the data given below, estimate the value of National Income (NNPFC):
S. No. | Items | Amount (₹ crore)
(1) Private Final Consumption Expenditure | 2,000
(2) Government Final Consumption Expenditure | 1,500
(3) Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation | 1,000
(4) Addition to Stock | 400
(5) Consumption of Fixed Capital | 50
(6) Net Factor Income from Abroad | 100
(7) Net Indirect Taxes | 200
(8) Net Exports | 700
(ii) Differentiate between Real Flow and Money Flow.
OR
(b) (i) Gauhar has recently completed her fashion designing studies and started a boutique. To produce dresses for sale, she purchased a sewing machine, fabric, buttons, and thread. These items are essential for producing the dresses. Classify the items purchased by Gauhar as final goods or intermediate goods, giving valid reasons in support of the classification.
(ii) "National Income is always equal to Domestic Income in a two-sector economy." Defend or refute the given statement with valid reasons.

key_points: Part (a)(ii): Real flow refers to flow of goods/services; Money flow refers to flow of money.
Part (b)(i): Sewing machine = Final good (fixed asset); Fabric/buttons/thread = Intermediate goods (inputs).
Part (b)(ii): Refute. National Income = Domestic Income + NFIA. In a two-sector economy, they are equal only if NFIA = 0.

questions.solution: (a)(i) GDPmp = Private final consumption expenditure + Government final consumption expenditure + Gross domestic fixed capital formation + Addition to stock + Net exports = 2000 + 1500 + 1000 + 400 + 700 = 5600 crore. National Income (NNPfc) = GDPmp - Consumption of fixed capital - Net indirect taxes + Net factor income from abroad = 5600 - 50 - 200 + 100 = 5450 crore. (a)(ii) Real flow is the flow of goods and services between sectors, while money flow is the flow of money as payment for those goods and services. (b)(i) The sewing machine is a final good because it is a fixed capital asset used in production. Fabric, buttons, and thread are intermediate goods because they are consumed or transformed during the production process. (b)(ii) The statement is refuted. National Income and Domestic Income differ by Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA). They are only equal if NFIA is zero.

(a) भुगतान संतुलन को परिभाषित करें ।

questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully: Balance of Payments (BoP) systematically summarise, the economic transactions of an economy with the rest of the world, over a given period of time. The BoP can be broadly divided into two accounts namely: current account and capital account. The current account measures the transfer of goods, services, income and transfers between an economy and rest of the world. The capital account reflects the net changes in financial claims on rest of the world.
(a) Define Balance of Payments.
(b) Differentiate between the two accounts of Balance of Payments.
(c) Give the meaning of Balance of Payments deficit with formula.

key_points: Systematic record of economic transactions with the rest of the world.

sub_questions.solution: Balance of Payments is a systematic record of all economic transactions of the residents of a country with the rest of the world during a given period of time.

key_points: Current account: Goods, services, income, transfers.
Capital account: Financial assets and liabilities.

sub_questions.solution: The current account records transactions involving goods, services, current income, and transfers. The capital account records transactions involving the purchase and sale of financial assets and liabilities, representing changes in financial claims on the rest of the world.

key_points: Deficit occurs when receipts are less than payments.
Formula: Autonomous payments > Autonomous receipts.

sub_questions.solution: A BoP deficit occurs when the total payments by a country to the rest of the world exceed its total receipts from the rest of the world for autonomous transactions. The formula is: Autonomous Payments > Autonomous Receipts.

questions.instruction_line_english: Options:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।

questions.solution: (a) I do not agree. Danish invested in physical capital by purchasing machinery and seeds. questions.text_english: "The British introduced many infrastructural development projects, which were largely driven by their own self-serving interests." Briefly explain any two main causes behind the infrastructural development undertaken by the colonial government.

key_points: 1. Logistics for transporting colonial goods.
2. Easier movement of troops for administrative control.

questions.solution: The British development of infrastructure like railways, ports, and roads was driven by two main goals. First, to facilitate the efficient transportation of raw materials from the hinterland to ports for export to Britain and the import of finished colonial goods into India. Second, to ensure the swift movement of British military troops across India to maintain political control and suppress any resistance against colonial rule.

(b) "भारत में ग्रामीण विकास को प्रोत्साहित करने व आजीविका संवर्धन में सूक्ष्म साख (micro credit) कार्यक्रम अति उपयोगी रहे हैं।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में वैध कारण प्रस्तुत करें।
questions.text_english:
(a) "In recent times, through various schemes and policies, the Government of India has taken vital initiatives to generate employment directly and indirectly." Justify the statement with valid arguments.
OR
(b) "Micro-credit programmes have been very helpful in supporting rural development and improving livelihoods in India." Do you agree with the given statement? Give valid reasons in support of your answer.

key_points: Part (a): Schemes like MGNREGA provide direct employment; Skill India promotes indirect employment.
Part (b): Yes. Micro-credit enables self-employment, reduces dependence on moneylenders, and boosts rural entrepreneurship.

questions.solution: (a) I agree. The government has launched schemes like MGNREGA, which provides guaranteed wage employment in rural areas (direct), and initiatives like 'Skill India' and 'Start-up India,' which foster entrepreneurship and enhance employability, leading to increased job creation (indirect). (b) Yes, I agree. Micro-credit programs have been crucial in providing accessible and affordable finance to rural entrepreneurs and self-help groups. This enables them to start small-scale enterprises, reducing their reliance on exploitative traditional moneylenders and fostering sustainable rural livelihood improvements.

questions.text: दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, भारत व चीन में कार्यबल के वितरण व उसके सकल मूल्य वर्धन की हिस्सेदारी की तुलना करें। (Table provided in paper)
questions.text_english: On the basis of the given data, compare and analyse the Distribution of workforce and its contribution to Gross Value added in India and China. (Table provided in paper)

key_points: Agriculture employs a larger share in India compared to its contribution to GVA.
China's workforce is more balanced across sectors, with significant GVA from industry and services.

questions.solution: Based on the data, India has a significantly higher proportion of its workforce employed in agriculture (43%) compared to China (26%), yet this sector contributes a small share to GVA in both countries. In India, the services sector is the dominant contributor to GVA (54%) with a workforce share of 32%. China shows a more balanced development structure where the industry sector (41% GVA) and services (46% workforce) contribute more significantly to output relative to workforce, indicating a more advanced structural transformation compared to India.

questions.text:
(a) (i) "हरित क्रांति को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए भारत सरकार ने उर्वरकों पर उपदान प्रदान किया था।" इस प्रकार के उपदान के पक्ष में किन्हीं दो मान्य तर्कों की संक्षिप्त व्याख्या करें। (ii) "8 अक्टूबर, 2021 की एक खबर के अनुसार, भारत सरकार ने एयर इंडिया में अपनी 100% हिस्सेदारी की बिक्री कर दी। एयर इंडिया के मूल संस्थापक टाटा संस ने बोली जीतकर एयरलाइन को ₹18,000 करोड़ में क्रय किया।" (1) भारत सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए इस कदम की पहचान करें। (2) सरकार द्वारा पहचाने गए कदम को क्रियान्वित करने के किन्हीं दो तरीकों का उल्लेख करें।
अथवा
(b) (i) "1991 के उपरांत, विदेशी क्षेत्रक में सुधारों के कारण विदेशी मुद्रा प्रवाह के आगमन में वृद्धि हुई।" उपरोक्त कथन की वैध तर्कों द्वारा पुष्टि करें। (ii) "योजना अवधि के दौरान सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र को भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में सशक्त भूमिका प्रदान की गई थी।" भारत सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए कदम के पीछे के तर्क को सत्यापित करें।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "To promote the Green Revolution, the Government of India provided subsidies on fertilizers to farmers." Briefly explain any two arguments in favour of such subsidies. (ii) "As per a news report dated 8 October 2021, the Government of India sold its entire 100% stake in Air India. Tata Sons, the original founder, won the bid and purchased the airline for ₹18,000 crore." (1) Identify the step taken by the Government of India. (2) State any two ways in which the identified step can be implemented by the government.
OR
(b) (i) "After 1991, reforms in the external sector led to an increase in foreign exchange inflows." Justify the given statement with valid arguments. (ii) "During the planning period, the public sector was given a dominant role in the Indian economy." Justify the rationale behind this step taken by the Government of India.

key_points: Part (a)(i): To encourage adoption of new technology by small farmers and ensure food security.
Part (a)(ii)(1): Privatization / Disinvestment.
Part (a)(ii)(2): Sale of equity, transfer of management control.
Part (b)(i): Removal of trade barriers, opening to FDI.
Part (b)(ii): Need for capital intensive development, infrastructure, and self-reliance.

questions.solution: (a)(i) Fertilizer subsidies were provided to encourage small farmers to adopt new technology (HYV seeds) and to make these inputs affordable to ensure food security for the country. (ii)(1) The step is Privatization. (2) It can be executed by selling government equity to private players or transferring management control to a private company. (b)(i) After 1991, trade barriers were removed, tariffs reduced, and FDI limits liberalized, which attracted foreign capital and increased exchange reserves. (b)(ii) The public sector was given a dominant role to build the capital base, develop infrastructure, and promote self-reliance in industries that required huge investments and had a long gestation period, which the private sector was initially unable to provide.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : जलवायु परिवर्तन व पर्यावरणीय वहनीयता दो ऐसे महत्त्वपूर्ण मुद्दे हैं... धारणीय कृषि एक महत्त्वपूर्ण समाधान के रूप में उभर कर आयी है। यह उन कृषि पद्धतियों से है, जो भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए संसाधनों को संरक्षित करती हैं... जैविक कृषि, स्मार्ट जलवायु तकनीक, आधुनिक सिंचाई प्रणाली जैसी धारणीय प्रथाएँ प्रारंभ में महँगी लग सकती हैं, परन्तु वे उत्पादकता व पर्यावरण संरक्षण में सुधार करके दीर्घकालिक लाभ प्रदान करती हैं।
(a) धारणीय कृषि को परिभाषित करें।
(b) "जैविक कृषि जैसी ধারণীয় কৃষি পদ্ধতিগুলি প্রাথমিকভাবে মোহর মনে হতে পারে, কিন্তু দীর্ঘমেয়াদি লাভগুলি প্রদান করে।" এই পদ্ধতিগুলির মধ্যে দীর্ঘমেয়াদি লাভগুলির উপর আলোচনা করুন।
(c)ভারতের মতো উন্নয়নশীল দেশে ধারণশীল উন্নয়নকে 促销করার জন্য দুটি  estrategies এর উল্লেখ করুন।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully: Climate change and environmental sustainability are two pressing issues... In this context, sustainable agriculture emerges as a crucial solution. It refers to farming practices that meet present needs while preserving resources for future generations... Sustainable practices like organic farming, climate-smart technologies, and modern irrigation systems may seem costly upfront, but they offer long-term benefits by improving productivity and environmental conservation.
(a) Define Sustainable Agriculture.
(b) "Sustainable agriculture practices, such as organic farming, may seem costly initially but offer long-term benefits." Discuss the long-term benefits these practices can provide.
(c) State any two strategies to promote sustainable development in a developing country like India.

key_points: Farming practices meeting present needs while preserving resources for the future.

sub_questions.solution: Sustainable agriculture refers to farming practices that aim to meet the requirements of the current generation while preserving essential natural resources for future generations.

key_points: Improved soil fertility.
Increased long-term productivity.
Environmental protection/stewardship.

sub_questions.solution: Long-term benefits include improved soil fertility and health, sustained or increased agricultural productivity, and better environmental stewardship. These practices ensure the resilience of the ecosystem and reduce the long-term degradation of land and water resources.

key_points: 1. Promotion of organic farming.
2. Efficient water management/irrigation.

sub_questions.solution: Two strategies to promote sustainable development in India include: 1. Incentivizing and promoting organic farming to reduce chemical dependence. 2. Implementing modern irrigation techniques like drip irrigation to maximize water efficiency.
